--- a/crates/martensite-tkmath/tests/mathutils_base_behavior.rs

@@ -79,2 +79,2 @@ fn coefficient_scaling_retains_extreme_power_of_two_results() {

+        martensite_cmath::powi(2.0_f64, -100)
@@ -83,2 +83,2 @@ fn coefficient_scaling_retains_extreme_power_of_two_results() {
-        compute_scale_factor(&[2.0_f64.powi(-100)]),
-        2.0_f64.powi(100)
+        compute_scale_factor(&[martensite_cmath::powi(2.0_f64, -100)]),
+        martensite_cmath::powi(2.0_f64, 100)
@@ -87 +87 @@ fn coefficient_scaling_retains_extreme_power_of_two_results() {
-    assert_eq!(compute_scale_factor(&[f64::MAX]), 2.0_f64.powi(-1023));
+    assert_eq!(compute_scale_factor(&[f64::MAX]), martensite_cmath::powi(2.0_f64, -1023));
